openDecisions.question: Where do 'registered/curated aliases' come from? The fixture has no alias field (fields: key, categoryKey, categoryUk, categoryEn, nameUk, nameEn).
options: Ship zero aliases now: SpeciesName supports an alias kind, exact match = canonical UK/EN only, backfill uses canonical labels only
Curate an alias list now in a separate reviewed JSON
Let users add aliases to own species (no UI in spec)
openDecisions.codeCost: Option 1 costs nothing beyond the schema column; 00 says 07 is the sole source of system names
openDecisions.recommendation: Option 1. Inventing aliases contradicts 00, and 03 warns ambiguous aliases between peoples must not auto-merge.
openDecisions.answer: Option 1: ship zero aliases. species_names has kind enum (label|alias); exact match = canonical UK/EN labels + any alias rows (none today) + own custom names.

openDecisions.question: Field naming during the compatibility window, and how the localized label reaches character views (no character endpoint takes a locale today).
options: Keep species/speciesOverride as string labels resolved by a new locale query param on every character read and mutation endpoint, add speciesId/speciesOverrideId
Keep species/speciesOverride strings as the uk/canonical label for old readers, add speciesId/speciesOverrideId plus a ref {id, key, isCustom, nameUk, nameEn}; FE picks the label by useLocale
Replace species/speciesOverride with ref objects (breaking type change)
openDecisions.codeCost: Option 1 threads locale through about 8 endpoints, FE hooks and cache keys; option 2 needs no new params and keeps current FE display code compiling; only client is apps/web
openDecisions.recommendation: Option 2. Inputs switch to speciesId/speciesOverrideId only, legacy text inputs removed (update schemas are .strict(), so a stale text payload gets a 400; create schemas are not strict and would strip it, acceptable because the generated web client is the only caller). The legacy string view fields are removed at cleanup.
openDecisions.specRef: 05 bullet 1; 01 locale fallback; 04 'Locale-correct labels from API'
openDecisions.answer: Inputs take speciesId / speciesOverrideId (uuid|null). Views REPLACE the string with species / speciesOverride: Nullable<SpeciesRefView> where SpeciesRefView = { id, key: Nullable<string>, labels: { uk, en } } (custom: both labels = entered name). FE picks labels[locale]. No locale threading through character endpoints. Typed change, Orval regenerates, every consumer updated in the same deploy.
